profiles.BASIC: 0<beta<1; fixed compact positive labor support; w>0; R>0; phi>=0; effective income e=w*l-(R-1)*phi>=0; utility real-valued, continuous, bounded, strictly increasing and strictly concave on NNReal.
profiles.SMOOTH: U is C1 on positive consumption with strictly positive derivative. C2 may be used only by curvature modules. No differentiability at zero is assumed.
profiles.CURVATURE: U is C2 on positive consumption and eventually -c*U_second(c)/U_prime(c)<=M for finite M and positive threshold. This is explicitly stronger regularity for the drift branch.
profiles.NONDEGENERATE: l_min<l_max are essential endpoints: each endpoint neighborhood has positive probability. Atoms are allowed, density is not required.
profiles.IID: Future labor histories carry product law nu^n; future draws are independent of predetermined wealth and past histories.
profiles.IMPATIENT: beta*R<1. Only stationary existence, drift and associated subcritical results use this restriction; Bellman and equilibrium definition do not.
profiles.LOCAL_IMPATIENT: A specified neighborhood has R bounded above/below away from zero, beta*R<=gamma_star<1, and uniformly bounded effective income and its span.
profiles.THRESHOLD: Either e_min>0 or the right derivative of U at zero is finite.
profiles.ATOM_INADA: e_min=0, positive probability of zero effective income, and U has infinite right derivative at zero.
profiles.FINITE_CAP: b>=0 is finite and phi=min(b,w*l_min/r) for r>0, phi=b for -1<r<=0.
profiles.NATURAL_CAP: r>0 and phi=w*l_min/r; equivalently normalized effective income is w*(l-l_min).
profiles.LABOR_MEAN_ONE: Integral of labor under nu is one; imposed for equilibrium aggregation, not Bellman existence.
profiles.PRODUCTION: f(0)=0; f continuous on NNReal and C2 on positive K; f_prime>0, f_second<0; f_prime tends to infinity at zero and to zero at infinity; 0<delta<1.
profiles.PATH_FEASIBILITY: Measurable nonanticipative plan; assets a_t measurable before labor_t; consumption after current labor; budget holds almost surely for every t; c_t>=0. Natural bound or no-Ponzi appears separately in each implication.
profiles.EXACT_DIAGNOSTIC: beta=1/2; R=3/2; w=3/2; l uniform on [2/3,4/3]; phi=2; U(c)=sqrt(c)/(1+sqrt(c)), U(0)=0.
profiles.PURE_EXCHANGE_DEBT: r>0, fixed w, debt d, tax r*d, tax-adjusted natural bound a>=d-w*l_min/r; bond clearing E[a]=d; not the fixed-cap capital economy.
